Saudi Arabia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided by the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Ryadh, Saudi Arabia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Sarajevo):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
In light of recent events and the deteriorating security situation in the Middle East, citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina are not recommended to travel to parts of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, especially in the territory of the border zone with the Republic of Yemen. Travel warnings also apply to the capital, Riyadh, and Dammam, where there have been attacks on airports, industrial facilities and civilian facilities.
NOTE:In accordance with the Decision of the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina dated April 15, 2026, amending the Decision on Visas, citizens of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia holding ordinary passports are exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit, and stay in the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina for the period from June 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026.
The total duration of stay for citizens of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in Bosnia and Herzegovina within the specified period may be up to 60 days.
he stay of citizens of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in Bosnia and Herzegovina under the aforementioned visa-free regime is permitted until September 30, 2026. For stays in Bosnia and Herzegovina after September 30, 2026, a visa is required.
Holders of diplomatic and official passports of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia are exempt from the visa regime when entering, exiting, or transiting through the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina for up to 90 days.
